title: No Number Solves x² + 1 = 0? Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
x - 3 = 0? Point at 3. x² = 4? Point at 2 or -2. But x² + 1 = 0 has no answer anywhere on the number line. Is the equation broken, or is the number line too small? This animated lesson opens Chapter 4 of NCERT Class 11 Maths, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations, for PUC and CBSE students.

You will see why a real square is never negative, watch the graph of y = x² + c lift off the x-axis live as c counts up, and prove in four steps that no real number solves x² + 1 = 0. We look back at how the number system grew before (negatives, fractions, root 2), meet Mahavira, Bhaskara and Cardan from the NCERT historical note, define i as the square root of -1, and see why multiplying by i is a quarter turn. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example (x² + 4x + 5 = 0), the exam trap about (-1)², an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.
